Does the video trace the seven-day moving average of confirmed daily COVID-19 deaths in India from March 2020 through April 2021 and identify when the series reaches its highest value?
What is the highest plotted value, and where does it occur relative to the last explicit month labels?

units.claim: All 1 required series appear in panel single chart.

units.claim: The seven-day moving average of confirmed daily COVID-19 deaths in India rises from 46.7314 in March 2020 to a local peak of 1115.3505 in October 2020, then falls to 137.2607 at an unlabeled point between February and March 2021 before rising again through the final plotted point.
units.computation: Start: 46.7314 at point_order 1. Local peak: 1115.3505 at point_order 101. Subsequent trough: 137.2607 at point_order 164. Final value: 3233.9229 at point_order 200.
accept: Describes an initial rise to 1115.3505 in October 2020.
Places the subsequent trough at 137.2607 between February and March 2021.
Describes a renewed rise through the final plotted point.
reject: Claims the series rises monotonically throughout the period.
Places the October 2020 local peak near 1210.5.

units.claim: The highest plotted value is 3233.9229 deaths at point_order 200, after the last explicit April 2021 anchor at point_order 186.
units.computation: The maximum across the table is 3233.9229 at point_order 200. It is higher than the October 2020 local peak (1115.3505) and the explicit April 2021 anchor (365.9172 at point_order 186).
accept: Identifies the maximum as 3233.9229 deaths at the final plotted point.
States that the maximum occurs after the last explicit April 2021 anchor.
reject: Identifies October 2020 as the overall maximum.
Claims that point_order 200 is an explicitly printed April 2021 value.

optional_valid: Mentions the local peak around October 2020 as part of the trend description.
Notes the low point in March 2021 before the final rise.
unsupported_to_avoid: Causal explanations for the rise or fall in deaths.
Comparisons with other countries or regions not present in the table.
Claims about daily new cases or other metrics not shown.
Precise values for months not included in the table summary.
review_notes: The table summary lists monthly anchor points plus a final point at point_order 200 with no x label; the final point is treated as the April 2021 endpoint for the extremum.
The trend unit uses only the minimal sequence needed to show the overall shape and the October 2020 local peak; individual monthly points are not split into separate units.
